book.name: SAN MATEO
book.title: TZOTIꞌ CꞌUL YET COLBANILE TZꞌIBN̈EBILCANO YU NAJ SAN MATEO

content: Yechel yin̈ huneꞌ kꞌin̈ yet mohyilal
Yichipaxico Comam Jesús yalni tet ebnaj, yanico Comam huntekꞌan yechel yin̈ cuybanile tuꞌ, yalni Comam hacaꞌ tiꞌ:
—Haꞌ anma awtebil yoc yul iskꞌab Comam Dios, lahan hacaꞌ yakꞌle anma yin̈ huneꞌ kꞌin̈ yecꞌtze huneꞌ naj rey yet ismohyi iscꞌahol.
Hayet cꞌulxa ye sunil, yanito naj ischejab yikꞌati ebnaj awtebil yin̈ huneꞌ mohyilal tuꞌ. Yajaꞌ machi hunu ebnaj isjetij.

Lahwi tuꞌ yanipaxto naj huntekꞌanxa ischejab, yalni naj tet ebnaj hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Halwe tet anma awtebil tuꞌ tato watxꞌebilxa itah. Manchejan potxꞌlaxo haycꞌon̈ inwacaxan, yeb hunmajanxa no nokꞌ caw bakꞌich, watxꞌebilxa sunil. ‘Asiꞌwe yin̈ kꞌin̈ tuꞌ,’ quexchi,” ẍi naj rey.
Yajaꞌ ebnaj awtebil tuꞌ, maẍticꞌa cam iscꞌul ebnaj istita. Huneꞌ naj to ilno ismunil, hunxa naj xin to ilno istxon̈.
Haxa huntekꞌanxa ebnaj xin, oc ebnaj howal yin̈ ebnaj chejab tuꞌ, ispotxꞌlax ebnaj yu ebnaj.
Hayet yaben naj rey huneꞌ tuꞌ caw tit ishowal naj. Ischejni naj issoldado ispotxꞌno ebnaj potxꞌwawom tuꞌ, isn̈uslaxpaxilo iscon̈ob ebnaj.

Lahwi tuꞌ yalnipaxo naj rey tuꞌ tet huntekꞌanxa ebnaj ischejab: “Sunil tzet chiocnico yin̈ huneꞌ kꞌin̈ tiꞌ watxꞌebilxa sunil, yajaꞌ ebnaj awtebil wuhan mach chisjeti ebnaj, yuxin mach istzano ebnaj yul yin̈ huneꞌ kꞌin̈ tiꞌ.
Wal tinan̈ asiꞌwe yulaj calle cat hechejniti sunil mac chiilcha heyu yin̈ huneꞌ kꞌin̈ tiꞌ,” ẍi naj.
Yet yaben ebnaj chejab huneꞌ tuꞌ, isto ebnaj yulaj calle, yiniti ebnaj sunil anma chiecꞌ bey tuꞌ. Ay anma cꞌul isbeybal, ay anma txꞌoj isbeybal. Caw xin nohilo teꞌ n̈a yu anma yin̈ huneꞌ kꞌin̈ tuꞌ.
Hayet yocto naj rey yilno anma cutxanxaco tuꞌ, yilni naj huneꞌ naj mach ayoco xil iskꞌap yet mohyilal.
Yalni naj rey tet naj: “¿Tzet mayu hawocti bey tiꞌ, machi xin xil hakꞌap yet mohyilal aycoj?” ẍi naj. Yajaꞌ xin maẍticꞌa takꞌwi naj.
Yalni naj rey tuꞌ tet ebnaj ischejab: “Cꞌalbawe yoj huneꞌ naj tiꞌ yeb iskꞌab naj cat heyanilto naj xol kꞌejholo, haꞌ bey tuꞌ xin chiokꞌo naj yin̈, cat isn̈etxꞌlaho yeh naj,” ẍi naj.
Wal xin chiwalan teyet, caw txꞌiꞌal mac awtebil yu Comam Dios yajaꞌ haywan̈n̈e mac chissiqꞌuilo Comam, ẍi Comam Jesús.
Chꞌen tohlabal chiakꞌlax tet naj yahaw Roma
Lahwi tuꞌ ishecꞌnilo isba ebnaj fariseo, islahtiꞌn̈en isba ebnaj yin̈ tzet chu yakꞌni aycꞌayo ebnaj Comam yin̈ hunu tzotiꞌ, cat yoc ebnaj akꞌocꞌule yin̈ Comam yalni.

Yuxin yato ebnaj haywan̈ ebnaj ayco yin̈ ispartido, yeb haywan̈ ebnaj ayco yin̈ ispartido naj Herodes iscꞌatan̈ Comam, yun̈e yilwen ebnaj Comam. Yalni ebnaj tet Comam: —Mam cuywawom, caw johtajan̈ tato hach tiꞌ isyelaln̈eticꞌa chawala, chacuynipaxo anma iswatxꞌen hacaꞌ choche iscꞌul Comam Dios. Machi xin comono chawabeto yin̈ tzet chal anma, yuto lahan yelapno anma yul hasat.
Yuxin, ¿tzet chawute hawalni yin̈ huneꞌ tiꞌ: Chꞌen tohlabal chiel jin̈ yu naj jahaw ay Roma, cꞌulmi jakꞌni chꞌen mato machoj? ẍi ebnaj.
Yajaꞌ wal Comam Jesús pet istxumnalo Comam tzet nabil yu ebnaj. Yuxin yal Comam: —Hex cheyal heba cꞌulal tiꞌ, ¿tzet yin̈ xin chesay yin̈ tzet chu waycꞌayan yul hekꞌab?
Yewe hunu chꞌen melyu cheyakꞌ yin̈ hetohlabal tuꞌ wilaꞌan nan̈, ẍi Comam. Yakꞌni ebnaj huneꞌ chꞌen denario tet Comam.
Iskꞌamben Comam tet ebnaj: —¿Mac najil ayco yechel sat yeb isbi yin̈ chꞌen? ẍi Comam.

Istakꞌwi ebnaj: —Yechel sat naj jahaw ay bey Roma, yeb xin isbi naj ayco yin̈ chꞌen, ẍi ebnaj. Yalni Comam xin: —Akꞌwe tet naj yahaw Roma, baytet yet naj yehi, cat heyakꞌni tet Comam Dios baytet yet Comam yehi, ẍi Comam.
Yet yaben ebnaj yalni Comam huneꞌ tuꞌ, caw cꞌayilo iscꞌul ebnaj, isbejnicano ebnaj Comam.
Iskꞌambe ebnaj saduceo yin̈ yet chiitzitzbican̈ camom
Yin̈ticꞌa huneꞌ tzꞌayic tuꞌ, ay huntekꞌan ebnaj saduceo bey ilno Comam Jesús. Ebnaj saduceo tuꞌ mach chayto ebnaj yul yanma tato itzitzbican̈ anma camnaxa, yuxin iskꞌambe ebnaj tet Comam:

—Mam cuywawom, halbilcano yin̈ isley naj Moisés hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Ta chicam yichamil hunu ix ix, machi xin yuninal naj yeb ix, yilal yikꞌni ix yuẍta naj camna tuꞌ, yun̈e ay yuninal naj yeb ix cat yoc yuninalo naj camna tuꞌ,” ẍiayoj.
Yajaꞌ yet hunel, coxoltiꞌan̈ ay hujwan̈ ebnaj yuẍtan̈e isba. Naj babel mohyi yeb huneꞌ ix yajaꞌ cam naj, machi xin yuninal naj yeb yixal tuꞌ, yuxin mohyi naj iscab yeb ix.
Yajaꞌ campaxo naj, hacticꞌapax tuꞌ yu naj isyox, masanta apni yin̈ naj ishuj, sunil ebnaj ikꞌlen ix.
Lahwi tuꞌ iscampaxo ix.
Yuxin hayet chiitzitzbican̈ camom, ¿mac ebnaj hujwan̈ tuꞌ chioc yichamilo ix yuto ishujwan̈il ebnaj mohyi yeb ix? ẍi ebnaj.
Istakꞌwi Comam Jesús tet ebnaj saduceo tuꞌ: —Hex tiꞌ, maẍtaj haꞌ ye heyu, yuto mach heyohtajo tzet chal yul Yum Comam Dios, yeb mach heyohtajo yip Comam.
Wal xin hayet chiitzitzbican̈ anma camom matxa chimohyi, yuto lahanxa chielico hacaꞌ ebnaj ángel ay satcan̈.
Yin̈ yet chiitzitzbican̈ anma camom tuꞌ, ¿tom maẍto cheyil yul Yum Comam Dios bay chal hacaꞌ tiꞌ?:

“Hanintiꞌan isDiosal naj Abraham, naj Isaac yeb naj Jacob,” ẍiayoj. Yuxin waxan̈ca cam ebnaj yajaꞌ mach cam ebnaj yin̈ huneln̈e. Yuto mach isDiosalo camom ye Comam Dios to isDiosal anma itzitz, ẍi Comam.
Yet yaben anma huntekꞌan cuybanile yal Comam tuꞌ caw cꞌayilo iscꞌul.
Chejbanile caw ecꞌbal yelapno yehi
Yet yaben ebnaj fariseo tato matxa yu istakꞌwi ebnaj saduceo tet Comam Jesús, iscutxbanico isba ebnaj.
Xol ebnaj tuꞌ xin ayco huneꞌ naj cuywawom yin̈ ley, haꞌ naj oc ilweno Comam, yalni naj:
—Mam cuywawom, ¿baytet chejbanile caw ecꞌbal yelapno xol chejbanile aycano yu naj Moisés? ẍi naj.
Istakꞌwi Comam tet naj: —Ochewe Comam Dios yin̈ sunil hecꞌul, heyanma yeb henabal.
Haꞌ xin huneꞌ chejbanile tuꞌ haꞌ babel yeb ecꞌbal yelapno xol huntekꞌanxa.
Haꞌ huneꞌxa iscab xin, lahan hacaꞌ huneꞌ babel, chal hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Xahan cheyil heyet anmahil hacaꞌ hexahann̈en heba,” ẍiayoj.
Hayet chicoyijen cabeb chejbanile tiꞌ, lan̈an coyijen huntekꞌanxa cuybanile akꞌbilcano yu naj Moisés, yeb tzet tzꞌibn̈ebilcano yu ebnaj ischejab Comam Dios, ẍi Comam tet naj.
Comam Cristo Iscꞌahol Comam Dios yehi
Hayet cutxantoco ebnaj fariseo tuꞌ,
iskꞌamben Comam Jesús tet ebnaj: —¿Tzet cheyute hetxumni yin̈ naj Cristo? ¿Mac yin̈ chitit naj heyalni? ẍi Comam. Istakꞌwi ebnaj: —Yin̈ naj rey David chitit naj, ẍi ebnaj.
Yalnipaxo Comam: —Yajaꞌ naj David tuꞌ, yal naj naj Cristo Yahawoj yet yakꞌlax yalaꞌ naj yu Comam Espíritu Santo yet yalni naj hacaꞌ tiꞌ:

content.text: Yal Comam Dios tet Wahawilan: “Ayan̈ tzꞌon̈no yin̈ inwatxꞌkꞌaban masanto chiwacojan mac ayco ishowal tawin̈ yalan̈ hawoj,” ẍi Comam, ẍi naj David.

content: ¿Tzet yin̈ xin yal naj David tuꞌ naj Cristo Yahawiloj tato yin̈ naj titna naj?
ẍi Comam.
Machi hunu ebnaj yu istakꞌwi yin̈ tzet yal Comam. Haꞌticꞌa yin̈ huneꞌ tzꞌayic tuꞌ xin matxaticꞌa hunu ebnaj hitzico iskꞌamben hunu tzet ye tuꞌ tet Comam.

footnotes.text: Isyelo Comam Jesucristo ta titna yin̈ naj rey David, yaj xin Yahawil naj ye Comam
